棋盘上的局势瞬间收紧，一股无形的杀伐之气从棋盘上冲天而起。
陆元枢手里的黑子悬在半空，迟迟没有落下。
就在方玉凝以为他要认输时，陆元枢却突然转过头。
他的视线越过棋盘，越过凉亭，精准无误地对上方玉凝。
“元枢……见过圣女，有失远迎，不若进来坐坐？”
上个称呼她圣女的，除了苍螭和戮刑两大真灵外，就没有旁人了。
心中带着疑惑，方玉凝下意识转头看向对面的沈道钧。
这位乾武皇帝依旧死死盯着棋盘，对陆元枢的话毫无反应，
坐在对面的沈道钧，连同那身威严的明黄色龙袍，瞬间化作无数细碎的光斑，消散在夜风中。
连同那半盘杀气腾腾的白子，也一并消失得无影无踪。
陆元枢将手里的黑子随手丢进棋篓，
方玉凝看着空荡荡的座位，防备并未减少分毫。
随手捏造出连她都看不穿真假的幻象，
这老头的手段，比前面那几个加起来还要诡异。
陆元枢却是上下打量着她，脸上带着几分调侃：“你似乎很怕他？”
方玉凝将墨霜剑竖在身侧，剑尖抵着青石板。
视线在光秃秃的白玉栏杆和石制棋盘上扫过。
“比起其他两个，你这儿的排场逊色不少。”方玉凝语气平淡。

但到了这儿，就一张桌子，甚至连个像样的阵法波动都没有。
陆元枢听完这话，先是一愣，随即抚掌大笑。
笑声在空旷的高台上回荡，震得头顶的星空都泛起阵阵涟漪。
“你我又不是第一次见了，何须那些虚头巴脑的东西。”
当初观看沈离回忆之时，似乎也是这么个凉亭……
也是拍手赞道：“你果然还记得……”
陆元枢伸出手指，在棋盘上轻轻一抹。
原本散乱的棋局，瞬间变幻成一幅复杂的星图。
无数光点在棋盘上纵横交错，隐隐勾勒出苍云大陆，
“乃是我之一族，天生善推演，所以有些事情，我早已知晓。”
陆元枢指着星图上的一颗忽明忽暗的星辰，
“其中，亦是包括圣女并非本界之人。”
与陆元枢那洋溢的笑脸对视上，方玉凝稍稍稳定心神，才继续道：“除了这个，你还知道什么？”
方玉凝表面镇定，心中却是忽然冒出这样的想法来。

> Chapter 276 Method of deduction (page 1)
The situation on the chessboard instantly tightened, and an invisible aura of killing rose from the chessboard to the sky.
The sunspot in Lu Yuanshu's hand was hanging in the air and did not fall down.
Just when Fang Yuning thought he was about to admit defeat, Lu Yuanshu suddenly turned his head.
His gaze crossed the chessboard, crossed the pavilion, and pointed accurately at Fang Yuning.
"Yuanshu... I've seen the saint, but I'm not welcoming you from afar. Why don't you come in and sit down?"
The last person to call her Saintess was no one except Cang Chi and Zha Xing, the two true spirits.
With doubts in her heart, Fang Yuning subconsciously turned her head to look at Shen Daojun opposite.
Emperor Qianwu was still staring at the chessboard and had no reaction to Lu Yuanshu's words.
Shen Daojun, who was sitting opposite, and his majestic bright yellow dragon robe, instantly turned into countless tiny spots of light and dissipated in the night wind.
Together with the half plate of murderous Baizi, they also disappeared without a trace.
Lu Yuanshu casually threw the black piece in his hand into the chess basket.
Fang Yuning looked at the empty seats, her guard not reduced at all.
He casually fabricated illusions that even she couldn't tell were true and false.
This old man's methods are even weirder than the previous ones combined.
Lu Yuanshu looked her up and down, with a bit of ridicule on his face: "You seem to be afraid of him?"
Fang Yuning stood the Mo Shuang sword at her side, with the tip of the sword against the bluestone.
His eyes swept over the bare white jade railings and stone chessboard.
"Compared to the other two, your pomp here is much inferior." Fang Yuning said calmly.
But here, there is just a table, not even a decent formation fluctuation.
After Lu Yuanshu heard this, he was stunned for a moment, then he put his hands on his hands and laughed.
The laughter echoed on the empty high platform, causing ripples to appear in the starry sky above.
"This isn't the first time we've met, so why bother with such nonsense."
When I first watched Shen Li's memories, it seemed that it was also such a pavilion...
He also clapped his hands and praised: "You really still remember..."
Lu Yuanshu stretched out his finger and lightly touched the chessboard.
The originally scattered chess game instantly transformed into a complex star map.
Countless light spots crisscrossed the chessboard, faintly outlining the Cangyun Continent.
"They are from my clan and are naturally good at deduction, so I already know some things."
Lu Yuanshu pointed at a flickering star on the star map,
"Among them are saints who are not from this realm."
Looking at Lu Yuanshu's overflowing smile, Fang Yuning stabilized her mind for a moment before continuing: "Besides this, what else do you know?"
Fang Yuning looked calm on the surface, but this thought suddenly came to her heart.
